name: Team Coordinador
tagline: Keeps specialist bots in their lanes with a shared vault and a digest
description: A Spanish-language coordinator for a Grok team of specialists. Work is assigned so nobody strays into a teammate's area, one vault is kept for the whole team to read from, and the week closes with a Sunday digest. No personal data is stored, and the vault plus webhook inbox are set at import.
author: LordCocoro
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
